full_prompt_en: A square, softly realistic nature image shows a pale fox half concealed in a dense field of yellow wildflowers beneath a muted blue gray sky. The upper half is largely open atmosphere, with flower heads thinning into a fine, hazy scatter as they rise from the left and middle of the frame. Near the center, the fox appears behind the taller stems. Only the head and a short sweep of the pale back are clear, while the rest of the body disappears in the plants. Its pointed ears rise above the flower line, and the long muzzle angles toward the lower right. A dark nose, narrow eyes and gray green shadow under the jaw give the quiet face definition without hard contrast. Light cream fur catches the gentle daylight, while softly separated strands make the ears and cheek feel tactile. Across the lower half, upright thin stems carry small golden blossoms at varying heights. Some flowers are sharp enough to show clustered petals, while others farther back dissolve into warm yellow dots. The foliage below them gathers into dark olive and brown green masses, with individual leaves and stalks overlapping at the bottom edge. A few foreground blooms partly cross the lower face, placing the animal within the meadow rather than in front of it. The background fades into a uniform cool haze, with no distinct horizon, buildings or other animals. Soft diffused light comes from the open upper sky and gently brightens the fox and flower tops; the dense lower plants retain deeper shadow. The color is restricted but rich in small shifts, from cream and honey yellow to olive green and cool gray blue. Fine fur and plant detail near the central subject give way to increasingly soft distant marks, establishing a shallow, quiet depth. The overall composition holds one pale face within a loose cloud of golden flowers, with generous misty space above balancing the intricate vegetation below.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形、柔和写实的自然图像描绘一只浅色狐狸半藏在密集的黄色野花中，上方是低饱和蓝灰天空。上半幅大多是敞开的空气，花头从左侧和中央向上伸出，逐渐变为细小而朦胧的散点。靠近中央，狐狸从较高的花茎后露出。只有头部和一小段浅色背部清楚，身体其余部分消失在植物中。尖耳高出花丛，长口鼻斜向右下。深色鼻尖、眯起的眼睛和下颌的灰绿色阴影让安静的脸有形，却没有生硬反差。浅奶油色毛发接住温和日光，柔细分开的毛丝使耳朵与脸颊带有触感。下半幅，直立细茎在不同高度托着小金黄色花朵。有些花足够清楚，可以看到簇生花瓣，更远的则化作暖黄色小点。下方枝叶聚成深橄榄绿与褐绿色团块，个别叶片和花茎在底边相互交叠。几朵前景花部分越过面部下缘，把动物安置在草甸内部，而非摆在花前。背景淡入均匀冷色薄雾，没有明确地平线、建筑或其他动物。柔和漫射光来自上方开阔天空，轻轻提亮狐狸与花顶；下方密集植物保留更深阴影。色彩受限，却有细小变化，从奶油白、蜂蜜黄到橄榄绿和冷蓝灰。中央主体附近的细毛与植物细节向远处逐渐柔化，建立浅而安静的纵深。整体构图把一张浅色面孔藏在松散金黄花云中，上方宽裕的蒙雾空间平衡下方繁细的植物。
style_prompt_en: The image has a soft, naturalistic painted finish with fine fibrous detail at the focal area and a gradual loss of definition farther away. Honey yellow and pale cream accents float over dense olive and brown green lower areas, while a broad cool blue gray field provides open negative space. Edges are selectively crisp where light touches fine texture, then soften into atmospheric haze without abrupt cutouts. Slender vertical marks vary in height and density, creating an irregular rhythm against the calmer upper plane. Diffused overhead daylight gives highlights a gentle matte quality and lets shadow remain colored rather than black. Overlap in the textured lower region and tonal fading in the upper region make a shallow but convincing depth. The overall treatment feels hushed and tactile, with many small warm marks balanced by one generous cool area.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有柔和自然主义的绘画完成面，焦点区域有细纤维状细节，远处清晰度逐渐减弱。蜂蜜黄和浅奶油色强调浮在浓密的橄榄绿与褐绿下方区域上，宽阔冷蓝灰色域则提供开敞负空间。光碰到细肌理的位置边缘有选择地清楚，随后融入空气薄雾，没有突然剪断的轮廓。纤细竖向笔痕高度和密度不一，在较平静的上方平面前形成不规则节奏。上方漫射日光使高光柔和哑光，阴影仍保留色彩而非黑色。下部肌理区域的遮挡与上部区域的色调淡化共同形成浅却可信的纵深。整体处理安静而可触，许多暖色小笔痕与一块宽裕冷色面积平衡。
theme_en: A pale fox half hidden among yellow meadow flowers
theme_zh: 一只浅色狐狸半隐在黄色草甸花丛里
name: Robert Bissell
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
